title: Clean-profile installation and PDF export from the reproducible add-on archive

installation.method: Extracted the built add-on archive into a new temporary GRAMPSHOME profile and ran Gramps CLI integration against it.
checks_passed: Native Gramps data import and model extraction
AC-01 through AC-19 cases exercised by scripts/verify_gramps.py
Invalid selection, invalid destination, existing-file protection, replacement and temporary-file cleanup
PDF generation from the installed archive, including ancestry, descent, citation numbering, notes, family links and source details

pdf.visual_review: One interior page was rendered at 100 dpi: no clipping was visible and the text block has even margins consistent with the configured 15 mm layout. This is a sample-page check, not a review of every page.

scope_limits: This run uses Gramps CLI in a new profile; it does not repeat installation through the graphical add-on manager.
The generated book is a synthetic fixture with test labels and is not a family-history example for publication.
Other Gramps Desktop versions, Gramps Web, a full-document visual review, and screen-reader review remain outside this run.
